description: This Java class handles the update command for interest rate chart slabs within the Fineract project. It processes incoming commands and delegates the update operation to the associated write platform service.

classes.name: UpdateInterestRateChartSlabCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for interest rate chart slabs, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: UpdateInterestRateChartSlabCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the InterestRateChartSlabWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by delegating the update operation to the write platform service, passing the entity ID, sub-entity ID, and command details.
